Kuwanda kwenhamba nhatu dzechisikigo dzinotevedzana ndi $3S$, uye zvinobuda pakuwanzanisa diki nehombe zvowedzerwa $1$ zvakaenzana ne $T^2$. Kana $S = 15$, ndeipi nhamba hombe pane idzi nhatu?

Kuwanda kwenhamba nhatu dzechisikigo dzinotevedzana ndi $3S$, uye zvinobuda pakuwanzanisa diki nehombe zvowedzerwa $1$ zvakaenzana ne $T^2$. Kana $S = 15$, ndeipi nhamba hombe pane idzi nhatu?
20261121-math-g06-1.s.s1.explain:
Danho 1: Kutora nhamba se $n-1, n, n+1$, zvinopa $3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.

Danho 3: Nhamba huru ndi $16$.

Nhamba mbiri dzechisikigo $A$ na $B$ dzinozadzikisa $A + 2B = 24$. Kana $A$ achitora kukosha kukuru kunobvira, kukosha kwa $B$ chii?
20261122-math-g06-1.thinking.0: Mashandiro ezvikamu nemadecimal, proportion, percentage, denderedzwa nehuwandu, avhareji
20261122-math-g06-1.s.s1.prompt: [E6 Ongororo yeMasvomhu] Mubvunzo weongororo nezve Mashandiro ezvikamu nemadecimal, proportion, percentage, denderedzwa nehuwandu, avhareji. Nhamba mbiri dzechisikigo $A$ na $B$ dzinozadzikisa $A + 2B = 24$. Kana $A$ achitora kukosha kukuru kunobvira, kukosha kwa $B$ chii?
20261122-math-g06-1.s.s1.explain:
Danho 1: Kurongazve equation kunopa $A = 24 - 2B$.
Danho 2: Sezvo $A, B \ge 1$ dziri nhamba dzechisikigo, $2B$ inofanira kuva diki kuitira kuti $A$ ave mukuru.
Danho 3: Nhamba diki yechisikigo ndi $B = 1$.
Danho 4: Panguva ino, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (pamusoro), saka $B = 1$.

20261119-math-g07-2.material: [M1 Ongororo yeMasvomhu (Pamberi)] Dambudziko rakaoma reongororo uchishandisa Equation yemutsetse. Kuwanda kwenhamba nhatu dzechisikigo dzinotevedzana ndi $3S$, uye zvinobuda pakuwanzanisa diki nehombe zvowedzerwa $1$ zvakaenzana ne $T^2$. Kana $S = 15$, ndeipi nhamba hombe pane idzi nhatu?
20261119-math-g07-2.s.s1.prompt: [M1 Ongororo yeMasvomhu (Pamberi)] Dambudziko rakaoma reongororo uchishandisa Equation yemutsetse. Kuwanda kwenhamba nhatu dzechisikigo dzinotevedzana ndi $3S$, uye zvinobuda pakuwanzanisa diki nehombe zvowedzerwa $1$ zvakaenzana ne $T^2$. Kana $S = 15$, ndeipi nhamba hombe pane idzi nhatu?
20261119-math-g07-2.s.s1.explain:
Danho 1: Kutora nhamba se $n-1, n, n+1$, zvinopa $3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.
Danho 2: Nhamba nhatu idzi ndi $14, 15, 16$.
Danho 3: Nhamba huru ndi $16$.
Danho 4: Kuongorora: $(14 \times 16) + 1 = 224 + 1 = 225 = 15^2$.
20261119-math-g07-2.s.s1.hint.0: Kutora nhamba dzinotevedzana se $n-1, n, n+1$ kunopa $3n$.

20261122-math-g07-1.title: Equation yemutsetse
20261122-math-g07-1.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Equation yemutsetse kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-math-g07-1.material: [M1 Ongororo yeMasvomhu] Mubvunzo weongororo nezve Equation yemutsetse. Nhamba mbiri dzechisikigo $A$ na $B$ dzinozadzikisa $A + 2B = 24$. Kana $A$ achitora kukosha kukuru kunobvira, kukosha kwa $B$ chii?
20261122-math-g07-1.s.s1.prompt: [M1 Ongororo yeMasvomhu] Mubvunzo weongororo nezve Equation yemutsetse. Nhamba mbiri dzechisikigo $A$ na $B$ dzinozadzikisa $A + 2B = 24$. Kana $A$ achitora kukosha kukuru kunobvira, kukosha kwa $B$ chii?
20261122-math-g07-1.s.s1.explain:
Danho 1: Kurongazve equation kunopa $A = 24 - 2B$.
Danho 2: Sezvo $A, B \ge 1$ dziri nhamba dzechisikigo, $2B$ inofanira kuva diki kuitira kuti $A$ ave mukuru.
Danho 3: Nhamba diki yechisikigo ndi $B = 1$.
Danho 4: Panguva ino, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (pamusoro), saka $B = 1$.
20261122-math-g07-1.s.s1.hint.0: Kukosha kwenhamba diki yechisikigo kwa $B$ ndi $1$.
